Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_ship_hit_record, read-only analysis. __fastcall(const float* v /*ECX*/, const float* lo /*EDX*/, const float* hi /*[ESP+4]*/), RET 4, result in ST0, body 004155B0-004155EE. Returns max(*lo, min(*v, *hi)): FCOMI at 004155C5 returns *lo when *lo > *v, then FCOMI at 004155DB returns *v when *v <= *hi and *hi otherwise. Used by 00826F10 at 008274F4 to clamp damage/10.0 into [0, 63]; the same arithmetic is inlined in that function's part loop at 00827693..008276BC. docs/SHIP_HIT_RECORD.md.
